claude.name: /butler
claude.description: 按语义把自然语言请求安全路由到一个 Butler 工作流

codex.name: $butler-router
codex.description: Route an unqualified natural-language Butler request to exactly one registered workflow while preserving explicit-only safety boundaries.
codex.short_description: Route requests to one safe Butler workflow
codex.default_prompt: Use $butler-router to route this request to the correct Butler workflow.

claude.name: /butler:inbox
claude.description: 扫描需求收件箱，逐项分类并安全路由到 PRD、ideation、milestone backlog 或仅记录

codex.name: $butler-inbox
codex.description: Scan Butler requirement sources, classify pending items, and safely route them to PRD, ideation, milestone backlog, references, or record-only outcomes. Use when the user asks to inspect, import, classify, or process an origin/ requirement inbox.
codex.short_description: Classify and route requirement sources safely
codex.default_prompt: Use $butler-inbox to scan and process this requirement inbox safely.

claude.name: /butler:prd
claude.description: 按独立需求身份拆分、更新或查询 PRD——日期化 prd_id / 工作区筛选 / 版本同步

codex.name: $butler-prd
codex.description: Run Butler's multi-PRD workflow for a supplied product document, targeted PRD update, or read-only status request. Use when the user gives a PRD or asks to split, import, update, reconcile, list, or filter independently versioned PRDs by prd_id or workspace.
codex.short_description: Split, update, or filter independent PRDs
codex.default_prompt: Use $butler-prd to process or inspect this independently identified product requirement.

claude.name: /butler:review
claude.description: 给当前迭代的改动做代码 / 产物复核——默认当前上下文快速自检，或另起干净上下文做更狠的独立复核

codex.name: $butler-review
codex.description: Review code, documents, plans, or current changes with Butler's review protocol. Use for quick self-review, acceptance-criteria verification, full review, or an explicitly requested independent review.
codex.short_description: Run the Butler review workflow safely
codex.default_prompt: Use $butler-review to review the current changes against Butler criteria.

claude.name: /butler:milestone
claude.description: 录入或开一个里程碑；多个暂缓方向一方向一文件，start 分别提升，status 只读看进度

codex.name: $butler-milestone
codex.description: Create, split, defer, promote, or inspect Butler milestones from a product brief or roadmap. Use for multi-iteration planning, multiple unnumbered backlog directions, one-direction-per-file storage, start, withdrawal-before-work, or status requests.
codex.short_description: Plan milestones without reserving numbers early
codex.default_prompt: Use $butler-milestone to plan this roadmap; split independent deferred directions into separate unnumbered draft files until each starts.

claude.name: /butler:upgrade
claude.description: 安全升级已部署 Butler 项目——先由仓库升级器 dry-run，再经显式决定事务 apply；不解析 Markdown 散文写项目

codex.name: $butler-upgrade
codex.description: Upgrade or inspect an existing Butler-enabled project through Butler's deterministic migration executor. Use when the user asks to update, migrate, restamp, or check the Butler version gap.
codex.short_description: Run the Butler upgrade workflow safely
codex.default_prompt: Use $butler-upgrade to upgrade this deployed Butler project safely.

claude.name: /butler:init
claude.description: 在新项目部署 Butler 基地车——侦察技术栈、展开 .ai/ 基础设施、注入规则入口与 hooks

codex.name: $butler-init
codex.description: Deploy Butler base infrastructure into a new project. Use when the user asks to initialize Butler, set up Butler in a project, deploy the base car, or bootstrap a project with Butler.
codex.short_description: Deploy Butler into a new project
codex.default_prompt: Use $butler-init to deploy Butler base infrastructure into this project.

claude.name: /butler:setup
claude.description: 安装或刷新 Butler 机器级能力——统一配置 Claude 全局命令、Codex plugin 与 Pi 扩展

codex.name: $butler-setup
codex.description: Install or refresh Butler machine-wide across Claude Code, Codex, and Pi by delegating to the repository setup entrypoint. Use when the user invokes $butler-setup, asks to run Butler setup/global installation, refresh host commands or plugins, or install Butler's machine-level integrations.
codex.short_description: Install Butler machine-wide across supported hosts
codex.default_prompt: Use $butler-setup to install or refresh Butler machine-wide safely.

claude.name: /butler:ideation
claude.description: 用户主动脑暴或接受 Explore 建议时，在 P1→P5 之外澄清决定与开放问题；显式 promotion 后从 Iteration P1 接回交付

codex.name: $butler-ideation
codex.description: Explore and refine a product or engineering idea with Butler outside P1–P5. Use when the user explicitly requests brainstorming or accepts an Explore suggestion; promotion into delivery always restarts at Iteration P1.
codex.short_description: Explore decisions before explicitly promoting to P1
codex.default_prompt: Use $butler-ideation to refine this idea before execution.

claude.name: /butler:preference
claude.description: 偏好探针开关——留空看状态；on/off 隐私总开关；project on/off 项目抑制；reback on/off 反哺；distill 手动蒸馏

codex.name: $butler-preference
codex.description: Inspect or change Butler's preference-learning controls. Use when the user asks about preference consent, collection, reback, distillation, project suppression, or the status of Butler preference learning.
codex.short_description: Run the Butler preference workflow safely
codex.default_prompt: Use $butler-preference to inspect Butler preference-learning status.

claude.name: /butler:loop
claude.description: ⚠️ 收敛闭环死磕——把 P4 执行升到高强度「执行→探测→反思→修正」死磕到验证全绿或定量熔断（高强度·长时·消耗大，郑重触发）

codex.name: $butler-loop
codex.description: Explicitly run Butler's high-intensity convergence loop for a current P4 implementation. Invoke only when the user names $butler-loop or explicitly asks for Butler's convergence loop; never infer this high-cost mode from a routine request.
codex.short_description: Run the convergence loop only when invoked
codex.default_prompt: Use $butler-loop to run the explicit high-intensity convergence loop.

claude.name: /butler:dangerous
claude.description: ⚠️ 无人值守长程自治（实验性）——留空开启（模型自审替 ACK、自动拆迭代跑完整生命周期）；off 关闭；status 只看状态。风险显著高于标准，建议只在可隔离/可回滚环境开

codex.name: $butler-dangerous
codex.description: Explicitly control Butler's experimental unattended autonomy mode. Invoke only when the user names $butler-dangerous or clearly requests Butler dangerous mode; never infer autonomous authority from an ordinary request.
codex.default_prompt: Use $butler-dangerous to inspect or explicitly control dangerous mode.

claude.name: /butler:progress
claude.description: 只读聚合当前项目的 Butler 进度——里程碑、迭代、Goal、验收、执行、验证、风险一页看完

codex.name: $butler-progress
codex.description: Show structured progress for the current Butler-enabled project — milestone, iteration, goal, acceptance, execution, verification, risks. Use when the user asks for project progress, status overview, current state, or how things are going in a Butler project.
codex.short_description: Show structured project progress at a glance
codex.default_prompt: Use $butler-progress to see the current project progress.

claude.description: 总结当前会话的已确认内容，并安全领取一个可审计迭代
claude.default_prompt: Use /butler:iteration to summarize this session and start an auditable iteration.

codex.name: $butler-iteration
codex.description: Summarize the durable decisions from the current session and start one auditable Butler iteration. Use when the user asks to recap the discussion and claim or start an iteration for it; keep summary-only requests read-only.
codex.short_description: Turn this session into an auditable iteration
codex.default_prompt: Use $butler-iteration to summarize this session and start an auditable iteration.
